# Code of conduct

Yume follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
It applies in issues, pull requests, discussions and any other space the
project runs, and when someone represents the project elsewhere.

In short: be kind and patient, assume good faith, and keep criticism about
the work. Many people here are learning Japanese, and some are learning to
program; questions at any level are welcome. Harassment, personal attacks,
and publishing someone's private information are not.

## Reporting

Report conduct problems to the maintainer,
[@swei9322](https://github.com/swei9322), privately rather than in a public
thread: while the project is in private alpha, through the channel you were
invited by. A dedicated contact address will be listed here once it exists.
Reports are kept confidential.

The maintainer decides what happens next, following the Covenant's
enforcement guidelines: from a private warning up to a ban from the project's
spaces.
